fluff.overview: Heavy plasma motorized platoons supplement standard assault rifles with man-portable plasma rifles that project superheated matter at targets. The plasma weapons combine the thermal effects of flamers with the penetrative capability of energy weapons, threatening both infantry and light armored targets. Mounted on light vehicles for rapid repositioning, these platoons deliver firepower well above what standard motorized infantry can bring to bear, though the plasma rifles are heavy and generate significant heat during sustained use.
